newsitem.title: UK: C&W shares down after negative press comment.
newsitem.headline: C&W shares down after negative press comment.

text.p: Shares in British telecoms group Cable & Wireless Plc dipped on Thursday after negative press comment following the stock's recent gains, traders said.
The stock was off 5p at 476-1/2 by 1333 GMT.

The Financial Times Lex column said C&W shares were "racing ahead of events" after the appointment of chief executive Dick Brown and that recent deals in Germany and the UK were "shrewd enough, but they do not kick the group into a different league."
C&W shares leapt higher last month after the company announced plans to acquire three cable operators to create Britain's biggest cable television operator.
Yesterday C&W posted a nine percent rise in underlying pre-tax profit for the first half of the year, ahead of most analyst expectations.
